purpose: Deterministic review contract for direct operator or official-host responses concerning the six unresolved HOY Family profiles.

profiles.release_rule: Core identity, primary contact and current/seasonal hours must be directly confirmed. Family inclusion additionally requires an explicit operator answer about the Peke Park relationship and customer access; visibility and separation may be published only when explicitly answered.
profiles.negative_family_rule: If the operator says restaurant customers do not have the claimed play-area relationship/access, route to remove_from_family_candidate_review rather than release_ready.

profiles.release_rule: The current weekly/seasonal schedule must be directly confirmed before precise time data can be promoted. Family claims require explicit operator confirmation and are never inferred from family-friendly descriptions or reviews.
profiles.negative_family_rule: If no customer-accessible play area exists, route to remove_from_family_candidate_review.

profiles.release_rule: Operator contact and menu are already operator-sourced; the unresolved time gate still requires direct confirmation. Family inclusion requires explicit confirmation of whose play area it is and whether restaurant customers may use it.
profiles.negative_family_rule: If the relevant play area is not accessible to Aquarium customers, route to remove_from_family_candidate_review.

profiles.release_rule: Conflicting current hours require direct confirmation. Peke Park proximity is not equivalent to customer access or visibility; those Family facts require explicit answers.
profiles.negative_family_rule: If proximity to Peke Park does not provide the claimed customer play use case, route to remove_from_family_candidate_review.

profiles.release_rule: The Zoco host listing is useful host evidence but its inconsistent schedule must not be promoted as precise time truth without direct confirmation. A business-specific online channel and menu improve the profile but are not fabricated if unavailable.
The material weekend-hours conflict must be resolved directly. Family geometry and suitability may be published only from explicit operator confirmation.
profiles.negative_family_rule: If the play area is not customer-accessible, route to remove_from_family_candidate_review.

decision_algorithm: Verify that the response authority is accepted under authority_policy; otherwise use it only as a lead.
Record each answered field independently; never treat a general confirmation as confirmation of unanswered facts.
If a direct answer contradicts existing material evidence, mark that field conflict and route the profile to conflict_review.
Do not change baseline status while any status_gate remains unanswered or conflict.
For profiles with family_gate fields, do not promote Family eligibility while customer access or the relevant relationship remains unanswered.
If a required Family premise is confirmed false, route to remove_from_family_candidate_review instead of forcing a release-ready Family profile.
Optional enrichment may be omitted or marked not published without inventing a value.
A fully satisfied contract produces eligibility for release review only; it never writes runtime or production data automatically.
